property: no statically-decidable failure path in the CI environment
reason: This check's aimed verdict — whether a settled product-spec document changed without a valid head-bound re-acceptance (the `engine-ack` commit status on the head) — compares each document's content at the pull request's base (read live from the GitHub Contents API at the base SHA) against its content at head, and reads the re-acceptance status live from the commit-statuses API. A committed fixture cannot manufacture a document that was 'settled at the base' or an `engine-ack` status on the head, because both are read from the API, not from any committed file. So the aimed failure cannot be forced by a seeded input in CI. The only committed-seedable path is the fail-closed branch, and witnessing a fixture via it would be a false witness. So there is no seedable, validly-witnessable failure path.
